name: modern-home-black-pantyhose-playful-squat
image_purpose: Fashion lifestyle post and home outfit visual

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic low-angle full-body fashion portrait in a bright modern home interior.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult blonde woman with long loose wavy hair, natural makeup, fair skin, and neutral manicured nails. She wears a fitted black long-sleeve mock-neck crop top, secure black shorts, sheer black tights, and chunky black platform loafers, holding a playful confident squat with hands resting naturally on her thighs.
prompt.composition_elements: Low-angle full-body vertical composition with the subject centered in an open space, knees comfortably bent and pose balanced. Include light wood or laminate flooring, white built-in cabinets or shelves with books and decor, clean modern design, and a subtle hallway or adjacent room.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright even indoor daylight with warm highlights on hair, skin, black fabric, tights, and shoe shine; soft natural shadows and playful home-fashion atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Smartphone or candid portrait look, full-body low angle, realistic stretch fabric, tights, leather and hair texture, natural depth of field, subtle digital grain, no artificial smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic full-body low-angle vertical fashion portrait of one approved adult blonde woman with long loose wavy hair, natural makeup, fair skin, and neutral manicured nails. She wears a fitted black long-sleeve mock-neck crop top, secure black shorts, sheer black tights, and chunky black platform loafers, holding a playful confident balanced squat with her hands resting naturally on her thighs. The bright modern home has light wood flooring, white built-in cabinets or shelves with books and decor, clean minimalist design, and a subtle hallway beyond. Bright even daylight, warm natural highlights, realistic fabric, tights, leather, hair, and skin texture, soft shadows, and candid lifestyle energy.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, child or teen appearance, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, harsh flash, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, deformed hands, random text, watermark, low resolution, blur
